checks.finding: Exact finite IDs exclude booleans; deterministic unique transition domain; accepting state has no outgoing transition; initial configuration pins every cell and exactly one head with declared initial state. No implicit arbitrary initial row.

All old triples over full alphabet plus wall, all collectors and full frame schemas are enumerated from owned machine before initial word/horizon processing. No statement/reachable-row/word/horizon trimming or per-instance prototype insertion occurs.

No-head triple preserves its plain center. One center head writes and moves/stays according to declared table; entering neighbor receives next state with its old scanned symbol. Undefined head transition removes every containing step triple. A center head moving into either wall has no tile, including both walls for width one. Neighbor-away wall safety is supplied by that neighbor head-centered tile in the same full row.

Only left frames have west exterior-left, and no tile has east exterior-left; only right frames have east exterior-right, and no tile has west exterior-right. Frames are forced exactly in extreme columns and cannot appear internally. Disjoint pair/seen constructors force each complete interior row to be step-kind or collector-kind.

Only collector interiors have south stop; no tile has north stop. Accepting frame south done also has no successor north done. Therefore only bottom row can collect and all preceding H rows are computation. Left seen0/right seen1 plus plain-preserve/accept-only0-to1 means exactly one accepting head; headless, nonaccepting or multiple accepting heads cannot pass.

Pinned top row has one head. Overlapping horizontal pairs reconstruct precisely its old triples with wall neighbors. Each complete step row therefore recovers the unique legal in-strip successor with exactly one head. Vertical induction across the H step rows reaches the collector north row, which must be accepting. This closes the reverse direction without assuming arbitrary malformed-row correctness.

Given a legal in-strip exact-H accepting run, its overlapping neighborhoods and matching frames instantiate every computation row; unique accepting collector flags finish it. Accepting heads have no outgoing transitions and collector/stop/done cannot continue, so a halted run cannot be padded to a larger exact time by these tiles.

For H=0 height is one, so bottom stop forces collectors immediately. Initial==accepting is allowed; a single accepting head can connect seen0 toseen1 even at W=1. Source explicitly interns every cell color, including an accepting initial head with no step output, so no missing color lookup obstructs this branch. If initial!=accepting, the pinned sole head has no collector and zero-step is impossible. These are literal Source/schema arguments, not generated fixtures or a tiling witness.

Every prototype has one unit center and four assigned midpoint edge values, including assigned color0. Translations are2Z2 only; board/frame centers and finite admissible origins coincide. Adjacent placements share exactly one relevant midpoint; nonadjacent placements share none. All exterior midpoint pins have zero occupancy contribution. Thus declared point occupancy/mark agreement is the finite square matching problem.

The exact finite admissible-origin restriction is essential and explicitly declared; master permits finite target/exterior data with admissible placements. No center R-role is needed for this stated finite-origin construction. Removing origin restrictions or interpreting prototype provenance field origin as a spatial transform is not covered. All palette IDs at every permitted origin and all midpoint dependencies remain future engine obligations.

Compiler returns candidate records only; private finite limits can stop compilation with no returned partial candidate. Direct external callbacks are not caught or converted. Read-only callbacks/exclusive input ownership remain explicit assumptions; no mutation seal, absolute preemption or runtime qualification is established.

conditional_lemma_latex: For a fixed declared deterministic partial machine \(M\), a complete one-head initial word \(C_0\in A^W\), \(W\ge1\), and exact \(H\ge0\), the full framed palette with the prescribed boundary on \((W+2)\times(H+1)\) has a tiling exactly when \(M\) has an in-strip legal accepting run of exactly \(H\) steps from \(C_0\).
